records.subject: Still want to get Quartz Dynamics set up on Wrenfield?
records.body:
Hi Ines,

A lot of teams stall right at inviting their first teammate. If that's where things got stuck, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Priya,

Thanks for the note -- we're still deciding if this is the right tool for our team, give it another week.

Ines

records.subject: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Good to see Quartz Dynamics has a real project going. Let me know if you want a second pair of eyes on how it's structured.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Quartz Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: First project reached 8/19 and welcome call held [calendar:ac5556dc], so some momentum. But Ines explicitly paused evaluation for a week [email:9c13141e], no invite sent, and only 8 days remain in the window — that deferral makes unaided key-milestone activation unlikely but not impossible.

draft.subject: Following up when you're ready, Ines
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for the straight answer — totally fair to take another week to decide whether Wrenfield is the right fit for your team. I won't crowd you in the meantime.

One thing that often makes the evaluation easier: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so seeing a teammate work alongside you in the project you've built tends to show the value faster than solo use. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it helps, I'm happy to spend 20 minutes with you this week or next looking at how your project is structured and whether it maps to how your team actually works. Just say the word.

Best,
Priya
